Resource_Provisioner.message: Resource_Provisioner status (iter 1): Inventory check complete for both hospitals. General_Hospital and St_Marys_Center both hold IV_Kits >= 6 and PPE_Sets >= 8 with wide margin (~20 units each) — no top-ups required this phase, no failures reported. Departments at both hospitals: proceed with scheduling; if any resource failure or shortage appears, report immediately and I will execute an emergency top-up in the same phase. Non-bottleneck requests (Oxygen_Tanks, Pain_Killers) will be handled just-in-time on request.
Resource_Provisioner.rationale: Confirming both hospitals are above safe bottleneck buffers so departments can schedule without gambling; avoids unnecessary transfers and holding cost while offering rapid response to any failure.
